adapter.zero_gate_contract: bit-exact stream tensor before the existing mHC mix

stages.name: inference_only
stages.decision: No nonzero gate may ship. This stage only tests immediate signal value.

stages.name: adapter_trained
stages.decision: Accept only if exact and long-context recall improve while ordinary coding and false-retrieval controls do not regress.

stages.name: context_reduction
stages.decision: ROSA must supply omitted exact source/tool spans without coding-quality loss.

failure_attribution.retrieval_signal: Exact span is absent or wrong before projection.
failure_attribution.projection_mixing: Retrieval is correct but hidden-state delta does not improve recall.
failure_attribution.lack_of_training: Inference-only fails and the trained adapter succeeds.
failure_attribution.false_retrieval: Useful controls pass while plausible-wrong or irrelevant controls regress.
failure_attribution.base_divergence: Zero-gate logits or tokens differ from the baseline.
